chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s with dark hair tied in a low bun, no headscarf, wearing a mustard-yellow short-sleeve work tunic over black trousers
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man in his early 30s with a short black beard, wearing a grey polo shirt and dark blue jeans
chars.MOM: a stern Moroccan woman in her 60s wearing a burgundy velvet djellaba and a white headscarf
chars.THUG: a skinny Moroccan young man with a buzz cut and a scar on his eyebrow, wearing a black tracksuit with white side stripes

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the sofa: WIFE bursts in through the front door of a traditional Moroccan living room in Fes with low sedari banquettes, patterned cushions and a zellige wall, running and screaming, her face red and panicked, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close shot in a traditional Moroccan living room in Fes with low sedari banquettes, patterned cushions and a zellige wall: WIFE with a red tear-streaked face screaming, HUSBAND jumping up from the banquette reaching toward her, shocked.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan living room in Fes with low sedari banquettes, patterned cushions and a zellige wall: WIFE pacing and unable to sit, hands on her head, while MOM sits on the banquette watching her coldly.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Kitchen doorway of a Moroccan home: HUSBAND gently splashing water from a small bowl on WIFE's face, worried, she is shaking.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan living room in Fes with low sedari banquettes, patterned cushions and a zellige wall: WIFE sitting on the banquette trembling and crying into her hands, HUSBAND kneeling in front of her holding her shoulders.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A narrow old derb alley in the Fes medina in the afternoon: THUG leaning on a wall smirking and blocking the path of WIFE who clutches her bag, scared.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A Fes medina alley with arches: WIFE walking fast and looking back over her shoulder in fear while THUG follows a few steps behind her.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan living room in Fes with low sedari banquettes, patterned cushions and a zellige wall: MOM standing up abruptly from the banquette, pointing her finger at WIFE with a mocking angry face, WIFE looking up at her stunned.
